remarks: " Love Where You Live" The Lafayette, Stamford's Newest Modern Building - Offering Bright Large Studios, Sleek & Spacious One and Two Bedroom Apartments. Showcasing European style cabinets, oversized windows, stone countertops and breakfast bar, + the convenience of an in-unit washer & dryer. Elevate your experience with an urban oasis on the expansive rooftop terrace with a variety of social spaces, from the lounge, to the dining and recreation areas - it's truly an awesome place to relax! The Lafayette features everything from a communal lounge to a dog wash, smart-building access, gym, and separate play area, plus secure parking. The Lafayette is located in a vibrant neighborhood of downtown Stamford & a quick stroll to restaurants and night life.  "Love Where You Live!"
